title: Micropolar Taylor-Green vortex: mu_eff against |k| l, and the two-mode solution
caption: The micropolar Taylor-Green vortex in the doubly periodic box [0, 2 pi)^2 (k = 1, |k| = sqrt 2, U0 = 1, Re = U0 / (k nu_inf) = 20, 50 on mu; K = 3; Ma 0.02; 400^2 particles, h = 5 dx; thesis numerics of Chapter 5). The field v = U(t) (sin kx cos ky, -cos kx sin ky), w = W(t) sin kx sin ky is an exact solution; U and W obey a linear 2 x 2 system (Section 18). (a) Decay rate of U of the micropolar run over that of its Newtonian control (viscosity mu + kappa / 2, the same particles and dt), fitted over 5 <= t <= 20, against |k| l: the quasi-steady mu_eff / (mu + kappa / 2) = 1 + 0.6 s / (1 + s), s = 0.625 (|k| l)^2 (solid; it tends to 1.6, dotted), the slow eigenvalue of the two-mode system with j = l^2 (dashed) and with j = l^2 / 100 (dash-dotted), the runs at 400^2 with j = l^2 (filled circles; bars: the largest floor of table 25), with j = l^2 / 100 (triangles) and with j = 1.5 l^2 (diamond), |k| l = 0.5 at 800^2 (open circle), and the exact two-mode solution fitted over the same window (crosses; at |k| l = 2 the fast mode, only 2.1 times faster, still enters the window). In a decaying flow the micro-rotation keeps spin from the earlier, larger vorticity: with j = l^2 the excess over mu + kappa / 2 is a third of the quasi-steady one at small |k| l, and with j = 1.5 l^2 (rho j (mu + kappa / 2) = gamma) w = omega / 2 is exact and the ratio is 1 at every |k| l. (b) The run |k| l = 1 with j = 0.755 l^2 (fast rate five times the slow one), started from W(0) = 0: U(t) and W(t) from the particles (projections on the two shapes; markers) against the exact two-mode solution (lines).
